messages.体力50%以上の敵へ撃ってダメージ量を乗せる、傲慢斬撃の高威力な単体E.G.O。: A high-power single-target Pride Slash E.G.O that deals extra damage when fired at enemies with 50% or more HP.
messages.高威力の単体攻撃: 1コインで基本威力10(解析Ⅲは15)、コイン威力+13。Z: **High-power single-target attack**: 1 Coin with 10 Base Power (15 at Threadspin Ⅲ) and +13 Coin Power. Its Clash Power is likely on the high side for a ZAYIN single-target attack.
messages.体力50%以上でダメージ量増加: 対象の体力が50%以上のときダメージ量+10%: **More damage at 50%+ HP**: +10% damage (+30% at Threadspin Ⅲ) when the target has 50% or more HP. It deals solid damage against high-HP enemies, especially those weak to Slash or Pride.
messages.出血付与: 的中時に出血2(解析Ⅲは4)を付与する。量は小さく、補助程度。: **Inflicting Bleed**: Inflicts 2 Bleed on hit (4 at Threadspin Ⅲ). The amount is small and only supplementary.
messages.精神力依存: コイン威力に頼るので、精神力が高い状態で撃つほど威力が安定する。: **SP-dependent**: It relies on Coin Power, so the higher her SP when firing, the more stable its power.
messages.初期E.G.O: 侵蝕スキルは無く、E.G.O侵蝕の対象にならない。: **Starting E.G.O**: It has no Corrosion skill and is not subject to E.G.O Corrosion.
messages.戦闘序盤、敵の体力が高いうちに撃ち、ダメージ量増加を乗せる。: Fire it early in a fight while enemy HP is high to get the damage increase.
messages.精神力が高いときに使い、コイン威力を活かす。: Use it when her SP is high to make the most of its Coin Power.
messages.必要資源は傲慢3・憂鬱1、精神消耗は10と軽い。: It requires 3 Pride and 1 Gloom, with a light Sanity cost of 10.
messages.Ⅱ: パッシブ「断絶」が解放される。精神力の回復効率+1・減少効率-1と、効果量: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks the passive Severance. +1 SP Heal Efficiency and −1 SP Loss Efficiency, a small effect.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力10→15、ダメージ量増加10%→30%、出血2→4で本格的になる: **Ⅲ**: Base Power 10→15, damage increase 10%→30%, and Bleed 2→4, bringing it into its own.
messages.Ⅳ: 次のターンの精神力回復効率+2・減少効率-2が付くが小さく、優先度は低いと: **Ⅳ**: Adds +2 SP Heal Efficiency and −2 SP Loss Efficiency for the next turn, but it is small, so likely a low priority.
messages.黒雲会若衆: S1(憂鬱)とS3(傲慢)で必要資源を出せ、S2が出血を付与する。: **[Kurokumo Clan Wakashu](persona:0902)**: S1 (Gloom) and S3 (Pride) supply the required affinities, and her S2 inflicts Bleed.
